column1: # The type table: one row for each type and method that gen/generator/generator.py runs on.
# gen/generator/gen.sh runs the rows. gen/generator/types_table.py reads the table for the Python tools.
# Columns are separated by one tab. A "-" is an empty column. A line that starts with "#" is a comment.
# package: the Go package of the type: v1alpha1 (proto/prysm/v1alpha1), v1 (proto/engine/v1) or primitives
#   (consensus-types/primitives). It gives the name of the .S file and the --type option.
# type: the Go type name. The directory of the outputs is lean/Prysm/<type>/.
# mode: the generator mode. uint64 and decoder --whole-accept read UnmarshalSSZ and write GeneratedDecodeAccept.lean.
#   encoder --fast-path reads MarshalSSZTo and writes GeneratedEncodeFastPath.lean.
# options: more generator options, separated by spaces. They come after the options that gen.sh makes from the row.
# expect: accept (exit 0, gen.sh writes the output) or refuse (exit 2, nothing on standard output, no file).
# companions: the files that the tools of gen/flat-types/ write for the type, separated by commas:
#   negative-cases (flat_types_negative_cases.py: the cases of the method of the row),
#   spec and hand-list are for the type: give them in one row of the type.
#   A person writes these files for a type without the companion.
# uint64: the accept path of the uint64 primitive decoders.
# decoder --whole-accept: the accept path and the size reject of a flat decoder.
# PendingPartialWithdrawal has interleaved fields, and AttestationData has nested containers.
# Flat types with tool-written companions, and flat types that the generator refuses.
# encoder --fast-path: the encoder fast path. The hand layouts and the statement tie need options.
